post.contentHtml:
At a Glance

Solid Inc. (050890, KOSDAQ), a telecom equipment maker, was hot enough this April to push its market capitalization past 1 trillion won. Recently, however, its share price has slipped to the low 8,000-won range. This article focuses on the gap between "a stock that surged on expectations and then cooled" and "actual earnings."

  • Recent share price: 8,050 won (data as of 2026-10-26; the closing price for October 30 could not be confirmed)
  • 1-year price change: -9.45%
  • 52-week high of about 20,900 won, low of about 6,260 won (based on the quote page at the end of September)
  • Median annual trading value: about 11.4 billion won

Why This Stock Is Interesting

1. The Gap Between the 52-Week High and Today

Compared with the 52-week high of about 20,900 won, the current share price is more than 60% lower. Yet the change versus one year ago is only -9.45%. In other words, the stock climbed sharply over the past year and then came back down, a highly volatile path. It was in the mid-9,000-won range at the end of September, so the price has fallen further since then.

2. Earnings Were a "Surprise"

Solid's 2025 consolidated revenue was reported at about 294.8 billion won, with operating profit of about 33.4 billion won. This beat the market forecast (operating profit of about 19.3 billion won), and a recovery in the North American market is said to have helped. First-quarter 2026 revenue was about 63.7 billion won, up 14.3% from a year earlier.

※ Operating profit is the profit from the core business: revenue minus the costs of producing, selling and running operations.

3. What Does the Company Do?

  • Founded in 1998, listed on KOSDAQ in 2005
  • It develops and supplies mobile network repeaters (equipment that fills in areas with weak signal), optical transmission equipment, and Open RAN-based base station equipment. Open RAN is a base station approach with open specifications so that equipment from different vendors can be mixed.
  • It has 10 subsidiaries and is expanding into defense communications (Solid Wintech) and aerospace and defense parts (Darwin Friction).

What to Watch Next

Item to CheckDetails
Q3 earnings releaseThe release appears to be scheduled around November 18. Brokerage estimates of operating profit vary by report, at roughly 8 to 9 billion won (these are only estimates, not confirmed figures).
Domestic spectrum reallocationAnalysts had linked it to the carriers' investment cycle, but we could not confirm any specific recent progress this time.
Expansion into defense and aerospace partsHow much the new businesses contribute to earnings remains to be seen.
ValuationAs of the end of September, PER (share price divided by earnings per share; the lower it is, the cheaper the stock looks relative to profit) was shown at around 12x. The share price has since fallen, so the current figure may differ.

Shareholder Structure

The largest shareholder, Jung Jun, and two related persons held 10.55% as of September 2026, up slightly from 10.44% in April 2025. Treasury shares declined from 1.01% in early 2024 to 0.81% in April 2025. No holding by the National Pension Service was confirmed. With the largest shareholder's stake in the 10% range, it is worth noting that management control cannot be considered especially solid.

Summary

Solid Inc. looks like a stock in which expectations first lifted the share price and which is now being tested against actual numbers. Whether the upcoming Q3 results meet market expectations could affect the share price, but that is only an estimate. Investors should also keep in mind that, as a KOSDAQ stock with relatively small trading value, it is highly volatile.

This article is not investment advice, and responsibility for any investment decision rests with the investor.
